parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: Configuration ID. It can be obtained by calling the [ListRewriteUrlRules](~~2867480~~) interface.

parameters.name: RewriteQueryStringType
parameters.description:
Query string rewrite type. Value range:
- static: Static mode.
- dynamic: Dynamic mode.

parameters.name: RewriteUriType
parameters.description:
URI rewrite type. Value range:
- static: Static mode.
- dynamic: Dynamic mode.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
Rule content, using conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true
- Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Rule switch. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. Value range:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: Rule name. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: Rule execution order. A smaller numeric value indicates higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) interface.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-rewrite-url-rule --site-id 1234567890000 --config-id 35281609690000 --rule-name example=123 --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --rewrite-uri-type static --uri /image/example.jpg --rewrite-query-string-type static --query-string example=123 --sequence 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateRewriteUrlRule --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234567890000 --RewriteUriType static --RuleEnable on --RewriteQueryStringType static --QueryString 'example=123' --ConfigId 35281609690000 --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --Sequence 1 --Uri '/image/example.jpg' --RuleName 'example=123'
